en: Sepia-toned view over a river valley toward a historic hilltop complex with multiple Gothic spires and large buildings, overlooking a town of dense houses and factory chimneys along the riverbank. A bridge crosses the river in the distance and a steamboat travels on the water. The foreground is framed by trees and foliage. Red printed German text appears in the upper left, with an additional handwritten red number on the right.
